title: The unfinished handoff
body: I left the spare key where you asked. The bus went past the property, but the office says our address was never on its pickup list. I thought you would come back for me.
rival_reading: A work crew could have used the route and kept its own address list; the letter cannot say why the bus passed.
gloss: A private apology is interrupted by a missing address on a pickup list.

cites.quote: I had an affair with Derek

title: Kept from the drawer
body: Two cups are set beside a test-day notebook. The only signed line is for the room key; a note asks that the sample page stay out of the household drawer.
rival_reading: A response team could have logged a sample during cleanup and kept records separate; the arrangement does not identify the test.
gloss: A private room key is signed out beside an unsigned test record.
